# ACD-T, 27 July 2026, Summary + EL Breakout (AI)

### Devnet 7 Status

- Network held up well over the weekend; now under heavier load with ramped-up transaction scenarios
- Gas builder issues: hitting gas limit problems, not winning bids; Nethermind builder also not winning bids
- Builder bid selection unclear: clients sometimes self-building despite higher external bids
  - Circuit breaker recently rolled out on devnet; may explain some rejections
  - Teku favors local blocks over bids ~90% of the time
  - Prysm logs every ignored bid; other clients should review their bid logging
  - <@425907307621122049>  on the chat: Teku merging bid reprocessing improvements today/tomorrow, will add debug logging with reasons
- Benchmarking started on devnet 7; most EL clients have optimizations merged
  - Erigon noted some performance regressions to investigate
  - New benchmark instructions (state actor) needed: <@850939574217342978>  to share link after the call

### Devnet 8 Planning

- Target launch: early August; next Wednesday floated but likely too tight
  - Repricing analysis started Friday; numbers not expected by Wednesday
  - Final repricing numbers needed before spec release and client runs
  - Decision deferred to next ACDT; revisit launch date then
- Key changes vs. devnet 7:
  - discv5-only (no v4 fallback) to surface real errors
  - Expanded chaos testing; more focus on SSZ and fork transition (fog transition underperformed in devnet 7)
  - Builder API changes (consensus-relevant due to client integration)
  - Attestation tracking fix (consensus breaking): confirmed going in, warrants new devnet
- EIP-8070 (sparse blob pool) engine API endpoints proposed for devnet 8 but there were concerns about overloading FCU with custody columns field; separate `updateCustodyColumns` (?) call discussed but no change agreed
  - Only the engine API part (get_blobs v3/v4); cell-level DAS deferred
  - Prysm, Lighthouse, Geth, Nethermind, Erigon all indicated no opposition (but this was before the concerns were raised)
  - FCU v4 custody columns parameter: currently optional in Geth; Lighthouse not yet sending it

### EL Breakout: EIP Changes for Devnet 8

- **[EIP-2780: fold transfer log cost into TX_VALUE_COST](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11997):** removes log cost charge for token transfer events; simplifies repricing EIP, affects create transactions only
  - Spec PR exists; no objections raised; going into devnet 8
- **[EIP-8037: rename "regular gas" to "execution gas" and update requires](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11998):** “regular gas” → “execution gas” for forward compatibility
  - Pure naming change, no behavior or consensus impact; specs already updated by Spencer
  - Minor debate on whether “execution gas” is accurate given call data / blob inclusion
  - Consensus: better than “regular gas”; no objections; merge on EL spec and include in devnet 8 release
- **EIP-7997 (no-op on mainnet):** two open PRs (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11991 and https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12009) proposing to track factory contract in witness at fork boundary
  - Current EIP text explicitly states clients must not check for contract existence at fork boundary
  - All clients except Geth already skip this; Geth has extra logic but is not married to it
  - Agreement: close both PRs, Geth to remove fork-boundary logic to align with other clients
  - No tests exist for the “factory not deployed” edge case; not specced, so not required for mainnet
  - Testing gap noted: if Geth behavior diverges, existing tests won’t catch it
